what: An Earth floats inside the panel (WebGL): a radius 1 sphere (30×30) painted with 3D noise for ocean and land, brighter on the lit side, with the edge blending into the background color. A radius 1.007 cloud shell overlaps it with additive blending .5 and drifts slowly on its own. The Earth spins turns rotations following document scroll progress (scrub 1). Colors are derived from the Skin (--kf-ink, --kf-bg, --kf-surface)

options.turns: Wheel turns while the document scrolls all the way down, default 1
options.distance: Camera distance (Earth radius 1), default 3.2 — smaller is bigger
options.track: Element (selector) to measure progress on — whole document if none

note: Load three (window.THREE) first — load three-global.js from this folder before _vendor/three@0.168.0/build/three.cjs. The original used photo textures (map·bumpMap) for the earth and clouds, here shader noise is painted with the same radius, face count, cloud density and additive blending

from.where: index.html .jl-globe (globe group behind the story — original earthGroup: Earth Sphere(1,30,30) + cloud Sphere(1.007) opacity .5 additive blending, rotated by a one-line timeline with scrub 1)
